name: @tacocat-gallery/api
description: The Cloudflare Worker behind the pix.tacocat.com photo gallery

scripts.dev: CI=true wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && env -u npm_config_workspace npm run --silent --prefix ../web build && wrangler dev --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.check: wrangler types --strict-vars=false --check && tsc -p . && tsc -p src && tsc -p test && tsc -p test/stack && tsc -p test/transcoder
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.deploy: env -u npm_config_workspace npm run --silent --prefix ../web build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: env -u npm_config_workspace npm run --silent --prefix ../web build && wrangler deploy --env production
